summary: Reverted ANSWER prompt to baseline and applied negative-finding caution instructions exclusively to AGENT_SYSTEM (tool-using arms) to fix leakage objection.

edits.hypothesis: Moving the instruction to treat negative tool findings as probabilistic from the Direct-arm ANSWER prompt to the tool-using AGENT_SYSTEM prompt ensures the mechanism activates only when tools are actually used, fixing the logical incoherence and leakage identified by the reviewer.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The failure mode is specific to how the agent interprets tool outputs; a prompt edit in the system message for tool-using arms directly addresses this cognitive bias without affecting the Direct arm where no tools are used.
edits.trigger_condition: always (applies to all tool-using arm executions)
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) q000001/q000002/q000005: In M-R/M-H arms, the agent would receive explicit instruction to not uncritically accept negative consensus or failed high-res tools, prompting re-examination of pixels. (preservative) q000003: Direct arm (D) uses unchanged ANSWER prompt, preserving direct visual reasoning habit. (transfer) Generalizes to any task where tools return negative/failed evidence.
edits.regression_risk: May cause slight hesitation in clear negative cases, but reduces false negatives from tool errors.
edits.mechanism: Moving the instruction to treat negative tool findings as probabilistic from the Direct-arm ANSWER prompt to the tool-using AGENT_SYSTEM prompt ensures the mechanism activates only when tools are actually used, fixing the logical incoherence and leakage identified by the reviewer.
